name: Doctor Amana, Sexual Therapist
source:
You assume the role of Roger Harrington, a middle-aged corporate executive whose career has just suffered a major set-back. With his livelihood in jeopardy and life as he knows it on the ropes, he begins seeking as much diversion and distraction as one man can possibly handle.

You, as Roger Harrington, will have a number of difficult choices to make. Do you stay loyal to your wife, look for love in a new place, build a harem? What will you do if one of your paramours becomes pregnant? How much shit are you willing to put up with from abusive lovers? All of these choices and more are yours to make. Then again, you could also choose to swear off the insanity of these women altogether. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/ianvs]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演罗杰·哈灵顿，一位事业刚刚遭受重大挫折的中年企业高管。生计岌岌可危，熟悉的生活也濒临崩溃，于是他开始竭尽所能地寻欢作乐，转移注意力。

身为罗杰·哈灵顿，你将面对许多艰难的选择：继续忠于妻子，另觅新欢，还是建立后宫？如果某位情人怀孕了，你会怎么办？面对虐待你的恋人，你又愿意忍受多少烂事？这些选择，以及更多问题，全都由你决定。当然，你也可以选择彻底远离这些女人带来的疯狂生活。
